Scope and remaining work Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component: This is an educational DSMC collision component. No spatial streaming, collision cells, speed-dependent hard-sphere selection, measured transport coefficients/flow fields or every-seed guarantee. Bird’s original hard-sphere conditions are not reproduced. DSMC collision component: finite-N equilibrium, invariants and statistical error: Statistical diagnostics cover fixed 64-seed ensembles, not every seed. Conservation correlates particles within a seed; do not use IID KS p-values. No spatial streaming, collision cells, speed-dependent hard-sphere selection or transport coefficients.
